speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an 8-month-old boy experiencing feeding difficulties and abdominal distension. To help me understand what is wrong, tell me: have you noticed any vomiting, and if so, does it ever look like coffee grounds or contain bile?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has been very fussy, feeding less than usual, and the abdomen looks distended. Crying gets worse when the belly is touched.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Intussusception. The infant's age, acute onset of abdominal distension, feeding difficulties, and specifically the worsening pain (crying) upon palpation are classic clinical signs. Please proceed to an Abdominal_Ultrasound to confirm the diagnosis.
